verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven SaaS identity platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a fair question, but the evidence shows no published spec: the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt docs index, Markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are adjacent machine-readable or agent-facing resources, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
